hero.valor: 4th year Computer Engineering student passionate about backend development, with internship experience and academic projects that demonstrate my ability to learn quickly and solve complex problems.

sobreMi.descripcion1: I am a Computer Engineering student at the University of Murcia, deeply passionate about large-scale backend development and artificial intelligence. My academic training is complemented by practical experience in real projects and a constant search for knowledge in the latest technologies.
sobreMi.descripcion2: During my career, I have had the opportunity to work on various projects ranging from software development to intelligent systems and communication networks. This diversity of experiences has allowed me to acquire a comprehensive view of the field of computer science.
sobreMi.descripcion3: Currently, I am focused on expanding my knowledge in cloud computing and artificial intelligence, areas I consider fundamental for the future of technology. My goal is to contribute to the development of innovative solutions that have a positive impact on society.

experiencia.descripcion: My most relevant experience in software development

practicas.titulo: Internship in Software Development and Integration
practicas.descripcion: Development and integration of payment module for PrestaShop using GNU Taler. Backend merchant setup, database and REST endpoints configuration. Full flow testing and technical documentation.

proyectos.descripcion: A selection of my most outstanding university projects, demonstrating my experience in software development, intelligent systems, and communication networks.

appchat.subtitulo: Full-featured chat application with contact, message, and user profile management
appchat.reto: Develop a robust chat application with advanced features and data persistence.
appchat.solucion: I implemented a complete application using Java and Maven, with JPA for persistence, JUnit for testing, and external libraries for advanced features.
appchat.impacto: Grade 9.5. Functional app with PDF report generation for premium users and efficient dependency management.

mitologia.subtitulo: Intelligent system to answer complex questions about Greek mythology
mitologia.reto: Create a system integrating ontologies and rule engines to model complex mythological domains.
mitologia.solucion: We developed a team prototype using Protégé for ontologies and Drools as a rule engine, capable of evaluating mythological event sequences.
mitologia.impacto: Grade 9.75. System able to generate complex answers about mythological feats and decisions.

nanofiles.subtitulo: Distributed P2P system for sharing and transferring files between users
nanofiles.reto: Implement a hybrid system combining a centralized server with direct P2P connections for efficient file transfer.
nanofiles.solucion: We developed a Java system with a centralized server managing users and files, and direct P2P connections using TCP for secure transfers.
nanofiles.impacto: Grade 10. Complete system with user registration, file publishing/downloading, and concurrent connection handling.

proyectosPersonales.intro: A selection of my most relevant personal projects, showcasing my skills in web development, backend, and cloud technologies. These projects reflect my passion for creating innovative solutions and my commitment to continuous learning.

portfolio.subtitulo: Personal website to showcase projects and skills
portfolio.descripcion: Development of my portfolio website using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Includes sections for projects, skills, experience, and contact form.
portfolio.reto: Create a modern and responsive website to showcase my professional profile.
portfolio.solucion: I used Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind for a fast and customizable experience.
portfolio.impacto: Professional online portfolio, improving my digital presence.

gestorTareas.descripcion: Web application to manage daily tasks with features for creating, editing, and deleting tasks. Includes category and priority system.
gestorTareas.solucion: I developed an app with React and Node.js, integrating MongoDB for persistence.
gestorTareas.impacto: Better time management and personal productivity.

elearning.descripcion: Simple educational platform where users can register, view courses, and complete lessons. Includes progress tracking and basic quizzes.
elearning.solucion: I implemented Vue.js and Node.js for the web, with Socket.io for real-time interaction.
elearning.impacto: Facilitates online learning for users with no prior experience.
